mapper.select: SELECT g.member_id, g.goal_name, mp.member_product_id, mp.item_name, mp.present_amount, mp.quantity FROM goal g INNER JOIN action act ON g.goal_id = act.goal_id INNER JOIN member_product mp ON act.member_product_id = mp.member_product_id WHERE g.member_id = #{memberId} AND g.goal_id = #{goalId} AND act.account_type = 'ISA'

SELECT g.goal_name, acc.account_id, acc.account_name, acc.account_balance * act.account_allocated_rate / 100 AS account_balance, acc.bank_code FROM goal g INNER JOIN action act ON g.goal_id = act.goal_id INNER JOIN account acc ON act.account_id = acc.account_id WHERE g.member_id = #{memberId} AND g.goal_id = #{goalId} AND act.account_type = 'Deposit'
